containment_limit: Inert route permits only pinned harmless fixtures and is not an arbitrary-code sandbox. Process-group absence alone does not cover group escapes. Native whole-container freeze/cgroup evidence is authored and source-controlled only; actual runtime qualification remains open.

current.engineering_evidence: Source construction and source-level checks do not establish numerical correctness, real containment, empirical competence or runtime qualification. Detailed engineering evidence remains external to this source distribution.
current.failure_accounting: Failed and unknown effects must retain their original costs, first error, acquired ownership and independent cleanup. Later successful work does not erase an earlier failed or unresolved outcome.
current.unavailable_observations: Only actually retained observations may support a completion claim. Missing intermediate observations are unavailable and must not be reconstructed as observed evidence.

historical: Unresolved completion, bounded-descendant and evidence-retention limits remain unresolved unless established by their original evidence. This public source distribution does not supply that external evidence or certify previous execution outcomes.
persistent_storage_failure: Explicit terminal hold and original outward exception/context can survive application writer failure; physical storage failure can prevent new durable details. No complete terminal persistence claim is made then.
scientific_limits: All24 original scientific/contract bodies,20stages42obligations240folds15graphs30000+12000 products and29 open gates preserved; numerical parity, real input bridges, native/resource/isolation qualifications and empirical competence are not established.
